title: Lyon §5.2 sparse-QR rank reduction (paper #Vars=192 form)
description:
metriko (Lyon's reference impl) reduces the consistency-constraint matrix M (2·#TQ × #TArc, ±1 entries) to its linearly-independent rows via sparse QR (see /tmp/metriko/include/metriko/core/solver/matrix_ops.h:reduce_to_linearly_independent). The rank of M IS the paper's #Vars (e.g. 192 for ROCKERARM) — variables that are fully determined by other vars get eliminated.

Our PATCH-72/84 union-find approach gets a fraction of this reduction by spotting same-count opposing-side patches. metriko's approach is more general: it works for any constraint structure including asymmetric T-junctions.

Implementation: build the constraint matrix as Eigen-style sparse, run sparse QR via ojAlgo's QR (or Apache Commons Math, or netlib BLAS via MTJ), get rank + permutation, project the var space onto the basis. Add to Quantization.solve before passing to ojAlgo's IntegerSolver.
definition-of-done: rocker-arm at α=15°: #Vars drops from current 2521 to ~192 (paper). Hand-30k similar 14× reduction. ILP solves in seconds (no more OOM fallback).
testing-plan: Toy 4-patch grid: rank reduction gives the analytically-known basis count. Rocker-arm: assert #Vars within 25% of paper's 192.
